points.quote: `createDecorator` (in `instantiation.ts`) returns a function that works as a parameter decorator and is also the service ID. The convention is that the interface and the identifier share the same name, with an `I` prefix.
Constructor parameter decorators declare the dependency: ... `@IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService,`
Instantiate such classes with `instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, staticArg)`. The service arguments are filled in from the collection.
It is called at module top level, typically in `*.contribution.ts` or `workbench.common.main.ts`-style files.
